name: Copter Cove
detailed_description:
🚁 Copter Cove – A Cozy Island Adventure from the Sky

Copter Cove is a cozy game set on a once-bustling island that's been quiet since a powerful storm hit five years ago. You inherit your late uncle's hangar and old, scrappy helicopter to help bring life back to Cove Island—one task, one flight, and one friendly face at a time.

Explore at your own pace—fly over forests, coastlines, and cliffs, or wander on foot through winding paths and quiet villages. Meet memorable NPCs, take on small quests, and work toward restoring the island’s lighthouse so visitors can return once more.

✿ Features

  • A Heartfelt World to Explore
    Fly or walk across a handcrafted open world filled with scenic views and island charm.

  • Story-Driven Quests
    Help quirky characters and complete tasks that move the story forward—each step bringing the island back to life.

  • Accessible Helicopter Flight
    Pilot your old chopper with simple arcade-style controls. It’s damageable, but easy to fly and forgiving for newcomers.

  • A Living Island
    Day/night cycles, gentle maintenance systems, and environmental storytelling create a relaxing sense of place.

  • A Small Game with Big Heart
    Developed solo by a single dev—Copter Cove is a focused experience with cozy vibes and a clear end goal: get the lighthouse working again.

Note: This is a small, solo-developed game. It’s not a big-budget production, but a personal, heartfelt project designed for players who enjoy quiet exploration, light storytelling, and games made with care.

short_description: It’s 1982. You’ve just inherited your uncle’s helicopter and hangar on distant Cove Island. Help the locals rebuild after the great storm—and uncover what really happened that eerie night, five years ago.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1080 or Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 or Radeon RX 6700
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
